title: Credit Risk Model & Early Warning Dashboard
summary: End-to-end credit scoring model that tells a lender whether to approve, review or reject a borrower, and flags existing borrowers before they default.
details: Trained on the public Kaggle Give Me Some Credit dataset: 150,000 borrowers, 6.68% default rate. Logistic regression (scorecard-style) reached 0.854 test AUC against 0.861 for XGBoost, so a bank can trade a little accuracy for a fully transparent model. Probabilities were calibrated with isotonic regression (6.6% mean predicted vs 6.68% actual). The cut-off is chosen by business cost rather than accuracy — treating a missed defaulter as 5x more expensive, the model flags 10.8% of borrowers and cuts expected cost by 36.2% against approving everyone. Risk grades A–E separate cleanly: 1.1% actual default in grade A rising to 36.8% in grade E, where 10% of borrowers account for roughly 55% of all defaults. SHAP explains every individual score, with credit utilisation the strongest driver.
note: Public, anonymised, non-Indonesian data. The method transfers to a bank's own portfolio; the data does not.

title: Bacterial Image Classification (Undergraduate Thesis)
summary: Deep learning system that classifies microscopic bacterial images by morphology, structure and staining, comparing ConvNeXt against ResNet-50.
details: Final-year thesis at Universitas Sriwijaya, built on the DIBaS (Digital Image of Bacterial Species) benchmark dataset. Two convolutional architectures — ConvNeXt and ResNet-50 — were trained with transfer learning and compared on classification accuracy across bacterial species, with a backend service serving predictions to a web front end so the model is usable outside a notebook.

title: CekSawit — Oil Palm Disease Expert System
summary: Expert system that identifies diseases in oil palm plants from field observations and returns practical treatment advice for non-technical operators.
details: Built from research and interviews with agricultural specialists, turning their diagnostic questions into a symptom questionnaire that returns a diagnosis and treatment steps. The interface is deliberately simple so a field worker, not an engineer, can reach a concrete next action. The repository also includes an RF-DETR object-detection training notebook for visual disease cues. Collaborator: Muhammad Azka.

title: Vehicle Route Tracking System
summary: Real-time tracking application monitoring company transport across 4 checkpoints, recording departure times, trip duration and stop locations.
details: Co-designed and built in a 2-person team during the Web Developer internship at PT Sumatera Prima Fibreboard. Monitors 10–20 trucks per day across 4 checkpoints, turning informal radio check-ins into structured, timestamped trip records. Trips are looked up by ticket ID, drawn on an interactive Leaflet map, and stored with start/end capture images in MongoDB, giving logistics managers real data on departure times, trip duration and stop locations.

title: Digital Document Approval System
summary: Role-based document workflow connecting administrators and managers across 8 manufacturing divisions, cutting the approval cycle from about a week to 2–3 days.
details: Built in a 2-person team at PT Sumatera Prima Fibreboard to replace paper memo routing between 8 divisions. Documents are uploaded, routed and approved through a role-gated API — only Manager and Standardization roles can act on an approval — with every decision, comment and status change written to an audit trail. Reduced the typical approval cycle from roughly one week to 2–3 days.

title: ALC Learning — Learning Management System
summary: Learning Management System running in production at Alpha Omega Learning Center, tracking daily grades, attendance and exercises for around 600 students.
details: The production system supporting academic assessments, daily exercises and learning modules for roughly 600 students, built with Express.js and a relational database and maintained through testing, deployment and iteration. The linked repository is the open companion build — a Next.js and Supabase grade manager with teacher authentication, class grouping, quiz and bonus scoring, attendance records, a class leaderboard and row-level security so each teacher sees only their own students. Accompanied by a separate cash flow auditing tool that surfaced IDR 19M in discrepancies over 9 months.

title: PT Dagangan Karya Indonesia — Sales Route Analytics
summary: Six months of sales, visit and customer data analysed for a rural-commerce startup to decide who sales reps should visit, how often, and on which days.
details: Capstone project of the Bitlabs Academy MSIB Batch 7 cohort, analysing visit, transaction and store-location data from April to September 2024 in a team of 3. Customers visited most often generated about 13x more revenue per customer than those visited least, and a 1–7 day visit cadence produced the highest average revenue. The recommendations — prioritise high-value customers, schedule around peak days such as Friday, reinforce weak days such as Sunday, and shorten routes (up to 40% less travel distance in test cases) — were presented as a final paper and executive deck, awarded Third Best Presentation Team in the national cohort.

title: IoT Smart Farming System
summary: Embedded sensor system for environmental monitoring and automated irrigation, placed Top 3 among 25–40 competing university teams.
details: University competition project combining soil moisture and environmental sensing with automated irrigation triggers, built on ESP32/Arduino microcontrollers. Placed in the top 3 of a field of 25–40 teams.

title: UI/UX Design Competition — National Finalist

details: Interface concept taken from user research through wireframes to an interactive Figma prototype, reaching the national finalist round of the Technology Euphoria 2024 design competition.

title: FASILKOM Isport Games — Event Operations
summary: Faculty-wide sports competition with 200+ participants across 6 sports, run as Head of Sport Division.
details: Organised and supported match operations for a faculty-wide competition spanning futsal, badminton, table tennis, chess, volleyball and basketball, coordinating schedules, officials and 200+ student participants.
